drift.note: endoscopy L-CNV score = mean over repeats of the maximum logit (as round 8 L3); time = years before the reference date (event / last sequenced endoscopy); endoscopy batch = the commonest sheet Batch of its samples; MAPD = median absolute difference of consecutive 50-kb log2 copy-number bins (QDNAseq copy_number.txt) within chromosomes; batch adjustment = minus the training non-progressor median of the sample's batch (>= 5 samples, else the global training non-progressor median); noise adjustment = residual on log MAPD, line fitted on training non-progressor samples; both refitted per outer fold; the held-out sample is adjusted with its fold's training constants
